summary: Phase-7 delivered a working AG-UI host scaffolder: a freshly scaffolded app builds, lints, and streams agent responses under `pnpm dev` with no second process, verified by 32 render snapshots of which 31 grew monotonically. Criterion 4 is PARTIAL rather than MET because 'renders in the browser' was verified at the store-reduction level, not in a rendered DOM — the scaffolder emits AgentPanel but does not mount it, so no browser was ever driven.
deltas_found: D-1 (most serious): the architectural ESLint config had NEVER run in any scaffolded app. scaffold-react-vite.sh wrote eslint.config.mjs while shadcn had already written eslint.config.js; ESLint loads one flat config and prefers .js. Proven with a probe file that should have errored and did not. Fixed — the same probe now errors correctly.
D-2: `pnpm build` was broken for every user. scaffold-react-vite.sh:711 set compilerOptions.baseUrl, which TypeScript 6.0.3 hard-errors on (TS5101). Removed rather than silenced.
D-3: `pnpm lint` failed on shadcn's own button.tsx via react-refresh/only-export-components. Fixed by registering the plugin with a vendored-UI exemption.

D-4: live protocol defect — our schema declared TOOL_CALL_ARGS_DELTA where @ag-ui/core@0.0.59 declares TOOL_CALL_ARGS, so conformant specs were rejected. Enum was also missing 10 of 23 kinds. Survived review because no example exercised the tool-call path.
corrective_actions: Three pre-existing base-scaffolder defects fixed (D-1..D-3), each approved by the operator when flagged.
Event enum corrected and a tool-call example added to close the corpus blind spot that hid D-4.
Five constraint gates written into change tasks as runnable commands after plan review found them described-but-unenforced.
polish-pass repaired to 11/11 COMPLETE after the apply driver misattributed a phase-7 change to it under G-7.

quality_gate.gate: adversarial-review (artifact-refiner QA not applicable — no refined artifacts, all changes are code or state)
quality_gate.recurring_pattern: 3 of 7 CRITICALs were one root cause: gaps with no research attached were silently dropped rather than given a recorded verdict (G-6, the openai-proxy option, G-3). A gap with no research still needs a verdict.
quality_gate.second_pattern: Both plan CRITICALs were describing constraint coverage instead of enforcing it — deferring gate creation to execute is planning work left undone.
quality_gate.isolation_note: analyze and plan ran true cross-model (verified-distinct). assess degraded to tier-2 (gateway 401); spec degraded because the packet builder supports only the native-kbd layout.

sycophancy_gate: unavailable — sycophancy.sh not installed; degraded gracefully per contract, no score recorded
technical_debt: G-7 HIGH: runtime returns committedLocally:true for writes absent from the audit log across 5 command types. Caused real corruption this phase. Deferral accepted by the operator; lives in the prometheus binary outside this repo.
No progress.json for phase-7 — the apply driver was disabled under the G-7 rule. Archived changes are the record.
Criterion 4 unproven in a DOM; AgentPanel is emitted but never mounted.
@ag-ui/* pre-1.0 pinned exact; @types/uuid is a runtime dep upstream, shipped into every scaffolded app.
CLAUDE.md:54 contradicts CLAUDE.md:31 on whether skills are listed in plugin.json — line 54 is stale.
kbd-analyze ships without research-pipeline.md or library-candidates.schema.json; adversarial-review's packet builder handles only the native-kbd spec layout.
recommendation_rationale: The A2UI domain already shipped (PR #1), and phase-7 built the entire substrate a host scaffolder needs — wrapper pattern, dev-middleware approach, store layering, and now-working ESLint enforcement. It is the cheapest phase that exercises that substrate a second time, which is how it gets validated as reusable rather than bespoke.
suggested_first: Browser-level test for criterion 4: mount AgentPanel and assert text growth in a real DOM. Closes the phase's only PARTIAL; Playwright is already in devDependencies.
Fix CLAUDE.md:54 — a one-line doc correction that caused a detour this phase.
